# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is dominated by **internal operations chatter** — loading/unloading coordination, driver call-outs, payment-follow-up pings, transporter haggling (Raipur/Nagpur/Vizag trans-calls), MTC/tag/test-certificate paperwork disputes, and short "hello/okay sir" confirmations. Genuine **sales** conversations (new enquiry, rate discussion, quantity/spec negotiation, order closing) are a smaller subset scattered across many dealer/customer names (Subhraa Metal, Sumangala Steel, Sparkline Vimal, SHANMUGANATHAN S, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Surya Raja/VLT, Thangaraj Metfra, TAMILARASAN KUMAR, V R Earth Movers, Uniqcore Const, SRC project site, etc.). This KB is built only from those sales-relevant exchanges. Given the mix, the picture is honest but partial — many calls are single-line stock checks or rate pings rather than full sales pitches, so some sections (e.g., formal objection scripts) are inferred from repeated patterns rather than one long scripted call.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC deals almost entirely in **structural/flat steel**, not roofing:

- **MS Plates / HR Plates** — thickness called out in mm (3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 30, 36, 40, 45mm), widths 1250/1500/2000/2500mm, lengths 6/6.3/8/10/12m. Grades discussed: **E250, E350 (BR/BO variants)** — E350 BO/BR flagged as rare/hard to source: "அதான் E 350 BR-னா ரொம்ப rare தான் sir கிடைக்கிறது" [E350 BR is very rare to get].
- **Checkered plates** (checker plate) — common sizes 8x4, 1500/2000/2500 width.
- **Coils** — plates cut from coil on demand; "coil-to-coil" (full coil + end-bits taken) gets ~₹500/ton cheaper than cut-plate.
- **Structural**: Angles, Channels (ISMC — "100 channel", "200 channel", "65/75 angle"), Beams (ISMB/UB/UC, and **NPB/MPB/NPP** as beam-family variants — "weight எல்லாம் ஒன்னுதான்... per meter-ஓட weight எல்லாம் ஒன்னுதான்" [weight per meter is identical across NPP/normal beam]), Flats, Square/Rectangular tubes (SHS/RHS — explicitly **not** a core SKU: "RHS-லாம் இதெல்லாம் தெரிஞ்சு நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல" [we don't deal in RHS]).
- **TMT rebar** — only **primary brands (SAIL, Vizag/RINL)**, no secondary: "Secondary இல்லை sir, oh, only sale-ஆ?" FE500D/500 flagged as scarce: "500 கிடைக்காது sir... 3 months-ஆ R&L production இல்ல" [500 grade unavailable, RINL hasn't produced it in 3 months].
- **Round rods / RHS / pipes** — explicitly declined: "இல்ல rounds நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல சார்" [we don't deal in round bars].
- **MS Binding wire** — sold in small lots (420–750 kg) for site projects (SRC Project).
- Brands referenced: SAIL, Vizag (RINL), Tata Steel, JSW, JSPL, NMDC, Apollo (pipe distributor referral), Suryadev, Maaveer (binding wire brand alt).
- Clear **wholesale-only policy**: "இது ரொம்ப small quantity sir. minimum 5 ton இருந்தாதான் பண்ணுவோம் sir" [minimum 5 ton order; we don't do retail].

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- 100 Channel: ₹61, later ₹61.50/kg; 40 square bar: ₹50/kg.
- Checker plate 8mm: ~₹65,000 (lumpsum quoted figure, GST extra).
- 6mm plate: ₹64/kg "இன்னைக்கு rate ₹64 sir" → 2m width adds ₹1,500 extra, totalling ₹65,500.
- 40mm plate: ₹12,500 base + ₹2,500 differential example quoted in one call.
- 300x150 vs 300x140 beam comparison: ₹60/kg vs ₹63/kg, weight difference ~4kg/meter (300x150 lighter at 42kg vs 46kg/m).
- 20mm plate: ₹67,500–₹70,000 per unit; 40mm plate ~₹75,000; differential ~₹7,500 for thickness step-up.
- Cutting charge: ₹500/ton flat fee for custom length cutting.
- Coil-to-coil (full coil incl. end-bit) discount: ~₹500/ton cheaper than cut-plate.
- TMT: no phone quoting of TMT rates — routed to a dedicated TMT person ("rate நம்ம phone-ல கொடுக்குறது இல்லை... அவரை call பண்ணுங்க sir").
- Price escalation repeatedly cited: "₹1000 per ton கூடி இருக்கு" / "₹1500 per ton increase" / "₹2000 increase ஆயிருக்கு" — company stance: rate validity is short (same-day/1–2 days), no retroactive honoring of old rate once it moves.
- **No credit sales** — advance payment mandatory: "Credit-ல தர மாட்டார் sir. Only advance payment தான்." Occasionally a short credit window floated by customer (receive now, pay in 4 days) but supplier side resists.
- Transport (inter-state, Vizag broker): ₹3,100 per ton Hyderabad–Coimbatore quoted as an example rate.
- Loading/halting penalty: "வண்டிய halt ஆனா ₹3000 halting charges" mentioned in a logistics-adjacent sales call.
- Door delivery vs ex-works distinguished explicitly in quotes ("door delivery கொடுத்திருக்கேன்" / "ex-work rate கொடுத்திருக்கேன்").
